--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local MissionContent = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MissionContent") :: ModuleScript)
local NPCNavigation = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("NPCNavigation") :: ModuleScript)

-- Ensure MissionRemotes folder and RemoteEvents exist
local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("MissionRemotes")
if not remotesFolder then
	remotesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotesFolder.Name = "MissionRemotes"
	remotesFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local requestActionRemote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("RequestAction")
if not requestActionRemote then
	requestActionRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	requestActionRemote.Name = "RequestAction"
	requestActionRemote.Parent = remotesFolder
end

local missionUpdateRemote = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("MissionUpdate")
if not missionUpdateRemote then
	missionUpdateRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	missionUpdateRemote.Name = "MissionUpdate"
	missionUpdateRemote.Parent = remotesFolder
end

type PlayerState = {
	stage: string,
	revision: number,
	ownerStatus: string,
	histories: {
		mati: { MissionContent.ChatMessage },
		scamerino: { MissionContent.ChatMessage },
	},
	lastActionTime: number,
	activeConversation: string,
}

local playerStates: { [Player]: PlayerState } = {}

local function getOrCreateState(player: Player): PlayerState
	local state = playerStates[player]
	if not state then
		state = {
			stage = "start",
			revision = 1,
			ownerStatus = "none",
			histories = {
				mati = {},
				scamerino = {},
			},
			lastActionTime = 0,
			activeConversation = "none",
		}
		playerStates[player] = state
	end
	return state
end

local function sendSnapshot(player: Player, state: PlayerState)
	local snapshot: MissionContent.MissionSnapshot = {
		revision = state.revision,
		activeConversation = state.activeConversation,
		histories = state.histories,
		choices = MissionContent.choices,
		status = state.stage,
		title = if state.activeConversation == "mati"
			then "MatiBuilds"
			elseif state.activeConversation == "scamerino" then "Scamerino Alertinio"
			else nil,
		interlocutorName = if state.activeConversation == "mati"
			then "MatiBuilds"
			elseif state.activeConversation == "scamerino" then "Scamerino"
			else nil,
	}
	(missionUpdateRemote :: RemoteEvent):FireClient(player, snapshot)
end

-- Teleport character to MissionStart SpawnLocation
local function teleportToStart(player: Player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	local missionStart = Workspace:FindFirstChild("MissionStart") :: BasePart?
	if rootPart and missionStart then
		rootPart.CFrame = missionStart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	end
end

local function beginEncounter(player: Player, revision: number?)
	local state = getOrCreateState(player)
	if revision and revision > state.revision then
		state.revision = revision
	end

	state.ownerStatus = "active"
	state.activeConversation = "mati"
	state.stage = "decision"

	-- Populate initial short messages from MatiBuilds per D-14, D-17
	state.histories.mati = {}
	for _, msg in ipairs(MissionContent.initialMatiMessages) do
		table.insert(state.histories.mati, {
			sender = msg.sender,
			text = msg.text,
			time = os.clock(),
		})
	end

	sendSnapshot(player, state)
end

local function cancelEncounter(player: Player)
	local state = playerStates[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end

	state.revision += 1
	state.stage = "closed"
	state.activeConversation = "none"
	state.ownerStatus = "none"
	sendSnapshot(player, state)
end

-- Register BindableEvents for cross-script server communication
local beginEncounterEvent = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("BeginEncounterEvent")
if not beginEncounterEvent then
	beginEncounterEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	beginEncounterEvent.Name = "BeginEncounterEvent"
	beginEncounterEvent.Parent = remotesFolder
end
(beginEncounterEvent :: BindableEvent).Event:Connect(function(player: Player, revision: number?)
	beginEncounter(player, revision)
end)

local cancelEncounterEvent = remotesFolder:FindFirstChild("CancelEncounterEvent")
if not cancelEncounterEvent then
	cancelEncounterEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	cancelEncounterEvent.Name = "CancelEncounterEvent"
	cancelEncounterEvent.Parent = remotesFolder
end
(cancelEncounterEvent :: BindableEvent).Event:Connect(function(player: Player)
	cancelEncounter(player)
end)

-- Handle player actions from client
local actionRemote = requestActionRemote :: RemoteEvent
actionRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, actionId: any)
	if typeof(actionId) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local state = getOrCreateState(player)

	-- Rate limiting: ignore rapid requests within 0.25s
	if now - state.lastActionTime < 0.25 then
		return
	end
	state.lastActionTime = now

	if actionId == "replay" then
		state.revision += 1
		state.stage = "start"
		state.activeConversation = "none"
		state.ownerStatus = "none"
		state.histories.mati = {}
		state.histories.scamerino = {}
		NPCNavigation.releaseOwner(player)
		teleportToStart(player)
		sendSnapshot(player, state)
		return
	end

	if actionId == "close" then
		state.revision += 1
		state.stage = "closed"
		state.activeConversation = "none"
		state.ownerStatus = "none"
		NPCNavigation.releaseOwner(player)
		sendSnapshot(player, state)
		return
	end

	-- Only allow choices when player is in 'decision' stage
	if state.stage ~= "decision" then
		return
	end

	local choice = MissionContent.getChoice(actionId)
	if not choice or not choice.enabled then
		return
	end

	-- Per D-14: append player's selected choice to history as their message
	table.insert(state.histories.mati, {
		sender = "Ty",
		text = choice.label,
		time = now,
	})

	-- Set next stage
	state.stage = choice.nextStage

	if choice.nextStage == "ending_bad" then
		table.insert(state.histories.mati, {
			sender = "MatiBuilds",
			text = "Dzięki za hasło! Zaraz się loguję i doładuję Robuxy...",
			time = now + 0.1,
		})
		table.insert(state.histories.mati, {
			sender = "System",
			text = MissionContent.texts.ending_bad,
			time = now + 0.2,
		})
	elseif choice.nextStage == "ending_good" then
		table.insert(state.histories.mati, {
			sender = "MatiBuilds",
			text = "Ehh, to jak nie chcesz darmowych Robuxów, to twoja sprawa...",
			time = now + 0.1,
		})
		table.insert(state.histories.mati, {
			sender = "System",
			text = MissionContent.texts.ending_good,
			time = now + 0.2,
		})
	end

	sendSnapshot(player, state)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	NPCNavigation.releaseOwner(player)
	playerStates[player] = nil
end)

--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Chat = game:GetService("Chat")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local NPCNavigation = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("NPCNavigation") :: ModuleScript)

local lobby = workspace:WaitForChild("MarketplaceLobby", 10) :: Instance?
local npc = lobby and (lobby:WaitForChild("ScammerNPC", 10) :: Model?)
if not npc then
	return
end

local hrp = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5) :: BasePart?
local head = npc:WaitForChild("Head", 5) :: BasePart?
local upperTorso = (npc:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or npc:FindFirstChild("Torso")) :: BasePart?
local lowerTorso = (npc:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or npc:FindFirstChild("Torso")) :: BasePart?
local humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

if not hrp or not head or not humanoid then
	return
end

humanoid.DisplayName = "MatiBuilds"

-- Ensure NPC can physically move via PathfindingService and server has network ownership
hrp.Anchored = false
pcall(function()
	hrp:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
end)

-- Per D-03: Disable ProximityPrompt so interaction is triggered by proximity approach, not [E]
local prompt = hrp:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
if prompt then
	prompt.Enabled = false
end

local neck = (head:FindFirstChild("Neck") or upperTorso:FindFirstChild("Neck")) :: Motor6D?
local waist = (upperTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist") or lowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist")) :: Motor6D?

local baseNeckC0 = if neck then neck.C0 else CFrame.new()
local baseWaistC0 = if waist then waist.C0 else CFrame.new()

local arbiter = NPCNavigation.getDefaultArbiter()

-- Breathing & Head tracking
local currentTargetPlayer: Player? = nil
local clock = 0

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	clock += dt

	-- Gentle breathing
	local breath = math.sin(clock * 2.2) * 0.02
	local sway = math.cos(clock * 1.5) * 0.015

	if waist and baseWaistC0 then
		waist.C0 = baseWaistC0 * CFrame.Angles(breath * 0.5, sway, 0)
	end

	-- Head tracking towards current target player or nearest player
	local targetChar = if currentTargetPlayer then currentTargetPlayer.Character else nil
	if not targetChar then
		local nearestDist = NPCNavigation.NOTICE_DISTANCE
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local char = player.Character
			if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char:FindFirstChild("Head") then
				local charHrp = char.HumanoidRootPart :: BasePart
				local dist = (charHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
				if dist < nearestDist then
					nearestDist = dist
					targetChar = char
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if targetChar and neck and baseNeckC0 then
		local targetHead = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
		if targetHead and upperTorso then
			local localPos = upperTorso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(targetHead.Position)
			local yaw = math.clamp(-math.atan2(localPos.X, localPos.Z) - math.pi, -math.rad(60), math.rad(60))
			local pitch = math.clamp(math.atan2(localPos.Y, -localPos.Z), -math.rad(25), math.rad(25))
			neck.C0 = baseNeckC0 * CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw, 0)
		end
	elseif neck and baseNeckC0 then
		neck.C0 = baseNeckC0 * CFrame.Angles(breath * 0.5, 0, 0)
	end
end)

local function triggerBeginEncounter(player: Player, revision: number)
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("MissionRemotes")
	local bEvent = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("BeginEncounterEvent") :: BindableEvent?
	if bEvent then
		bEvent:Fire(player, revision)
	end
end

local function triggerCancelEncounter(player: Player)
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("MissionRemotes")
	local cEvent = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("CancelEncounterEvent") :: BindableEvent?
	if cEvent then
		cEvent:Fire(player)
	end
end

-- Patrol waypoints
local basePos = hrp.Position
local patrolPoints = {
	basePos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	basePos + Vector3.new(6, 0, -5),
	basePos + Vector3.new(-6, 0, -4),
	basePos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 6),
}
local currentPatrolIdx = 1

local isNavigating = false

task.spawn(function()
	while npc and npc.Parent do
		task.wait(0.5)

		-- Check for nearby candidate players within notice distance (28 studs)
		local bestCandidate: Player? = nil
		local bestDist = NPCNavigation.NOTICE_DISTANCE

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local char = player.Character
			local charHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
			if char and charHrp and charHrp.Parent then
				local dist = (charHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
				if dist <= bestDist then
					bestDist = dist
					bestCandidate = player
				end
			end
		end

		if bestCandidate and not isNavigating then
			local claimSuccess = arbiter.tryClaim(bestCandidate)
			if claimSuccess then
				isNavigating = true
				currentTargetPlayer = bestCandidate
				local token = arbiter.getToken(bestCandidate)

				-- Walk to player with obstacle avoidance
				local navResult = NPCNavigation.walkToPlayer(
					npc,
					bestCandidate,
					{ stopDistance = NPCNavigation.STOP_DISTANCE, timeout = NPCNavigation.PATH_TIMEOUT },
					token
				)

				if navResult == "arrived" and not (token and token.isCancelled) then
					-- Turn to face player
					local targetChar = bestCandidate.Character
					local targetHrp = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
					if targetHrp then
						hrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
							hrp.Position,
							Vector3.new(targetHrp.Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, targetHrp.Position.Z)
						)
					end

					-- Emit single public shout bubble per D-09
					pcall(function()
						Chat:Chat(
							head,
							"Siemka! Masz super skin, widać że znasz się na grze :)",
							Enum.ChatColor.Green
						)
					end)

					-- Start simulated private chat encounter
					local revision = if token then token.revision else 1
					triggerBeginEncounter(bestCandidate, revision)

					-- Monitor distance and interaction state
					local interactionStartTime = os.clock()
					local gavePressureShout = false

					while bestCandidate and bestCandidate.Parent and arbiter.isOwner(bestCandidate) do
					task.wait(0.2)
					local char = bestCandidate.Character
					local cHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?

					if not char or not cHrp or not cHrp.Parent then
						break
					end

					local currentDist = (cHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
					-- Distance break per D-11
					if currentDist > NPCNavigation.BREAK_DISTANCE then
						triggerCancelEncounter(bestCandidate)
						arbiter.releaseOwner(bestCandidate)
						break
					end

					-- Pressure shout if no response after FOLLOW_GRACE (5s) per D-10
					if
						not gavePressureShout and (os.clock() - interactionStartTime > NPCNavigation.FOLLOW_GRACE)
					then
						gavePressureShout = true
						pcall(function()
							Chat:Chat(
								head,
								"Zostało ostatnie miejsce w giveawayu Robuxów, zaraz przepada!",
								Enum.ChatColor.Green
							)
						end)
					end
					end
				else
					-- Path blocked or timeout
					arbiter.releaseOwner(bestCandidate)
				end

				currentTargetPlayer = nil
				isNavigating = false
			end
		elseif not isNavigating then
			-- Idle patrol
			local targetPoint = patrolPoints[currentPatrolIdx]
			humanoid:MoveTo(targetPoint)
			local reached = false
			local conn = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function()
				reached = true
			end)

			local waitTime = 0
			while not reached and waitTime < 4 do
				task.wait(0.2)
				waitTime += 0.2
			end
			conn:Disconnect()

			currentPatrolIdx = (currentPatrolIdx % #patrolPoints) + 1
			task.wait(math.random(2, 4))
		end
	end
end)

--!strict
-- Idle patrol; the mission helper can pause it before taking ownership of movement.
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local modelInstance = workspace:WaitForChild("ScamerinoAlertinio", 15)
if not modelInstance or not modelInstance:IsA("Model") then
	return
end
local model = modelInstance :: Model
local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local rootInstance = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not humanoid or not rootInstance or not rootInstance:IsA("BasePart") then
	return
end
local root = rootInstance :: BasePart
local home = root.Position
local random = Random.new()
local revision = 0
local moving = false

local function paused(): boolean
	return model:GetAttribute("ScamerinoPatrolPaused") == true
end

model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ScamerinoPatrolPaused"):Connect(function()
	revision += 1
	if paused() and moving then
		humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
	end
end)

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model }
root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

while model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and humanoid.Health > 0 do
	if paused() then
		task.wait(0.2)
		continue
	end
	local capturedRevision = revision
	local angle = random:NextNumber(0, 2 * math.pi)
	local radius = random:NextNumber(6, 12)
	local target = home + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * radius, 0, math.sin(angle) * radius)
	local ground = workspace:Raycast(target + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0), Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), rayParams)
	if not ground or ground.Normal.Y < 0.8 then
		task.wait(0.5)
		continue
	end
	local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
		AgentRadius = 3,
		AgentHeight = 7,
		AgentCanJump = false,
		WaypointSpacing = 4,
	})
	local ok = pcall(function()
		path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, ground.Position)
	end)
	if not ok or path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
		task.wait(1)
		continue
	end
	local blocked = false
	local currentWaypoint = 2
	local connection = path.Blocked:Connect(function(index)
		if index >= currentWaypoint then
			blocked = true
		end
	end)
	moving = true
	for index, waypoint in path:GetWaypoints() do
		if index == 1 then
			continue
		end
		currentWaypoint = index
		if paused() or capturedRevision ~= revision or blocked then
			break
		end
		humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
		local deadline = os.clock() + 5
		repeat
			task.wait(0.1)
			local delta = root.Position - waypoint.Position
			if Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude < 1 then
				break
			end
		until os.clock() >= deadline
			or paused()
			or capturedRevision ~= revision
			or blocked
			or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		if os.clock() >= deadline or paused() or capturedRevision ~= revision or blocked then
			break
		end
	end
	connection:Disconnect()
	-- Never overwrite a new movement owner's command after a pause/cancel.
	if capturedRevision == revision and not paused() then
		humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
	end
	moving = false
	task.wait(random:NextNumber(1.5, 3))
end

--!strict
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

local NPCNavigation = {}

-- Named configuration constants per D-08, D-10, D-11
NPCNavigation.NOTICE_DISTANCE = 28
NPCNavigation.STOP_DISTANCE = 7
NPCNavigation.BREAK_DISTANCE = 32
NPCNavigation.FOLLOW_GRACE = 5
NPCNavigation.PATH_TIMEOUT = 8

export type NavigationResult = "arrived" | "cancelled" | "no_path" | "timeout" | "lost_player"

export type NavigationToken = {
	isCancelled: boolean,
	revision: number,
	cancel: () -> (),
}

export type ArbiterConfig = {
	noticeDistance: number?,
	stopDistance: number?,
	breakDistance: number?,
	followGrace: number?,
	pathTimeout: number?,
}

export type Arbiter = {
	getOwner: () -> Player?,
	tryClaim: (player: Player, revision: number?) -> boolean,
	enqueue: (player: Player) -> (),
	advanceQueue: () -> Player?,
	releaseOwner: (player: Player) -> Player?,
	cancelPlayer: (player: Player) -> (),
	isOwner: (player: Player) -> boolean,
	getToken: (player: Player) -> NavigationToken?,
	createToken: (player: Player, revision: number) -> NavigationToken,
	getQueueLength: () -> number,
}

function NPCNavigation.createToken(revision: number?): NavigationToken
	local token = {
		isCancelled = false,
		revision = revision or 1,
	}
	token.cancel = function()
		token.isCancelled = true
	end
	return token
end

function NPCNavigation.newArbiter(_config: ArbiterConfig?): Arbiter
	local currentOwner: Player? = nil
	local ownerTokens: { [Player]: NavigationToken } = {}
	local queue: { Player } = {}
	local queueTimes: { [Player]: number } = {}

	local arbiter: Arbiter = {} :: Arbiter

	function arbiter.getOwner(): Player?
		return currentOwner
	end

	function arbiter.isOwner(player: Player): boolean
		return currentOwner == player
	end

	function arbiter.getToken(player: Player): NavigationToken?
		return ownerTokens[player]
	end

	function arbiter.getQueueLength(): number
		return #queue
	end

	function arbiter.createToken(player: Player, revision: number): NavigationToken
		local prevToken = ownerTokens[player]
		if prevToken then
			prevToken.cancel()
		end

		local token = NPCNavigation.createToken(revision)
		ownerTokens[player] = token
		return token
	end

	function arbiter.enqueue(player: Player)
		if currentOwner == player then
			return
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(queue) do
			if p == player then
				return
			end
		end
		table.insert(queue, player)
		queueTimes[player] = os.clock()

		-- Sort FIFO by enqueue time, tie-break by UserId per D-24
		table.sort(queue, function(a, b)
			local tA = queueTimes[a] or 0
			local tB = queueTimes[b] or 0
			if tA == tB then
				return a.UserId < b.UserId
			end
			return tA < tB
		end)
	end

	function arbiter.tryClaim(player: Player, revision: number?): boolean
		if currentOwner == nil then
			currentOwner = player
			arbiter.createToken(player, revision or 1)
			return true
		end
		return currentOwner == player
	end

	function arbiter.advanceQueue(): Player?
		while #queue > 0 do
			local nextPlayer = table.remove(queue, 1)
			queueTimes[nextPlayer] = nil
			if nextPlayer and nextPlayer.Parent and nextPlayer.Character then
				currentOwner = nextPlayer
				arbiter.createToken(nextPlayer, 1)
				return nextPlayer
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	function arbiter.releaseOwner(player: Player): Player?
		if currentOwner == player then
			local token = ownerTokens[player]
			if token then
				token.cancel()
				ownerTokens[player] = nil
			end
			currentOwner = nil
		end
		return arbiter.advanceQueue()
	end

	function arbiter.cancelPlayer(player: Player)
		for i, p in ipairs(queue) do
			if p == player then
				table.remove(queue, i)
				queueTimes[player] = nil
				break
			end
		end
		local token = ownerTokens[player]
		if token then
			token.cancel()
			ownerTokens[player] = nil
		end
		if currentOwner == player then
			currentOwner = nil
		end
	end

	return arbiter
end

-- Default shared arbiter for MatiBuilds
local defaultArbiter = NPCNavigation.newArbiter()

function NPCNavigation.getDefaultArbiter(): Arbiter
	return defaultArbiter
end

function NPCNavigation.cancelPlayer(player: Player)
	defaultArbiter.cancelPlayer(player)
end

function NPCNavigation.releaseOwner(player: Player): Player?
	return defaultArbiter.releaseOwner(player)
end

function NPCNavigation.walkToPlayer(
	character: Model,
	targetPlayer: Player,
	options: { stopDistance: number?, timeout: number? }?,
	token: NavigationToken?
): NavigationResult
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not humanoid or not rootPart then
		return "no_path"
	end

	local targetChar = targetPlayer.Character
	if not targetChar then
		return "lost_player"
	end
	local targetRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not targetRoot then
		return "lost_player"
	end

	local stopDistance = if options and options.stopDistance then options.stopDistance else NPCNavigation.STOP_DISTANCE
	local timeout = if options and options.timeout then options.timeout else NPCNavigation.PATH_TIMEOUT

	-- Immediate proximity check
	local initialDist = (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
	if initialDist <= stopDistance then
		humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
		return "arrived"
	end

	local startTime = os.clock()

	-- Path calculation
	local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
		AgentRadius = 2.5,
		AgentHeight = 5.0,
		AgentCanJump = false,
		WaypointSpacing = 4.0,
	})

	local computeSuccess, _ = pcall(function()
		path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetRoot.Position)
	end)

	if not computeSuccess or path.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success then
		-- Fallback to direct MoveTo if path computation is blocked or failed
		humanoid:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position)
		local moveFinished = false
		local conn = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function()
			moveFinished = true
		end)

		while not moveFinished do
			if token and token.isCancelled then
				conn:Disconnect()
				humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
				return "cancelled"
			end
			if os.clock() - startTime > timeout then
				conn:Disconnect()
				humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
				return "timeout"
			end
			if not targetChar.Parent or not targetRoot.Parent then
				conn:Disconnect()
				return "lost_player"
			end
			if (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude <= stopDistance then
				conn:Disconnect()
				humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
				return "arrived"
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		conn:Disconnect()

		if (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude <= stopDistance + 2 then
			humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
			return "arrived"
		end
		return "no_path"
	end

	local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
	for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
		if token and token.isCancelled then
			humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
			return "cancelled"
		end

		if os.clock() - startTime > timeout then
			humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
			return "timeout"
		end

		if not targetChar.Parent or not targetRoot.Parent then
			humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
			return "lost_player"
		end

		local currentDist = (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
		if currentDist <= stopDistance then
			humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
			return "arrived"
		end

		humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)

		local reachedWaypoint = false
		local conn = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Connect(function()
			reachedWaypoint = true
		end)

		local waypointWait = 0
		while not reachedWaypoint and waypointWait < 1.5 do
			if token and token.isCancelled then
				conn:Disconnect()
				humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
				return "cancelled"
			end
			if (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude <= stopDistance then
				conn:Disconnect()
				humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
				return "arrived"
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
			waypointWait += 0.05
		end
		conn:Disconnect()
	end

	local finalDist = (rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
	if finalDist <= stopDistance + 2 then
		humanoid:MoveTo(rootPart.Position)
		return "arrived"
	end

	return "arrived"
end

local function renderSnapshot(snapshot: MissionContent.MissionSnapshot)
	if snapshot.status == "start" or snapshot.status == "closed" or snapshot.activeConversation == "none" then
		chatFrame.Visible = false
		return
	end

	chatFrame.Visible = true
	titleLabel.Text = snapshot.title or "MatiBuilds"

	-- Clear and rebuild message history
	clearContainer(messageScroll)
	local messages = if snapshot.activeConversation == "scamerino"
		then (snapshot.histories and snapshot.histories.scamerino or {})
		else (snapshot.histories and snapshot.histories.mati or {})

	for _, msg in ipairs(messages) do
		renderMessageBubble(msg)
	end

	-- Auto scroll to bottom
	task.defer(function()
		messageScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 99999)
	end)

	-- Render choices
	clearContainer(choicesContainer)

	if snapshot.status == "decision" then
		for _, choice in ipairs(snapshot.choices) do
			if choice.enabled then
				-- Neutral slate-blue for both choices per D-14
				createChoiceButton(choice.label, Color3.fromRGB(36, 82, 138), function()
					requestActionRemote:FireServer(choice.id)
				end)
			end
		end
	elseif snapshot.status == "ending_good" or snapshot.status == "ending_bad" then
		createChoiceButton("Zagraj ponownie", Color3.fromRGB(52, 152, 219), function()
			requestActionRemote:FireServer("replay")
		end)
	end
end

	end
end)

-- Embedded in the exported model. Server drives replicated Motor6D.C0.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local model = script.Parent :: Model
local humanoid = model:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
local root = model:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
local torso = model:WaitForChild("Torso") :: BasePart
local names = {"Left Hip", "Right Hip", "Left Shoulder", "Right Shoulder"}
local motors: {Motor6D} = {}
local rests: {CFrame} = {}
for _, name in names do
	local motor = torso:WaitForChild(name) :: Motor6D
	table.insert(motors, motor)
	table.insert(rests, motor.C0)
end
root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
local phase = 0
local blend = 0
local connection: RBXScriptConnection?
connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
		for i, motor in motors do motor.C0 = rests[i] end
		return
	end
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
	local walking = speed > 0.2 and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
	local goal = if walking then 1 else 0
	blend += (goal - blend) * math.min(dt * 10, 1)
	if walking then phase += dt * 2 * math.pi / 0.95 end
	local swing = math.sin(phase) * blend
	motors[1].C0 = rests[1] * CFrame.Angles(swing * 0.40, 0, 0)
	motors[2].C0 = rests[2] * CFrame.Angles(-swing * 0.40, 0, 0)
	motors[3].C0 = rests[3] * CFrame.Angles(-swing * 0.14, 0, 0)
	motors[4].C0 = rests[4] * CFrame.Angles(swing * 0.14, 0, 0)
end)
